query:
SELECT e.encounter_id, e.encounter_type, e.admit_date, e.discharge_date,
       p.provider_id, p.first_name, p.last_name, p.username
FROM aurora_ehr.encounters e
JOIN aurora_ehr.patients v ON v.patient_id=e.patient_id
JOIN aurora_ehr.providers p ON p.provider_id=e.attending_provider_id
WHERE v.is_vip=1 AND e.encounter_type='Inpatient'
  AND e.admit_date >= '2025-11-01' AND e.admit_date < '2025-12-01';

SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.role, COUNT(*) AS accesses
FROM aurora_audit.access_log a
JOIN aurora_audit.users u ON u.user_id=a.user_id
WHERE a.patient_mrn='AH-0044719'
GROUP BY u.user_id,u.username,u.role
ORDER BY accesses DESC;

SELECT change_id, record_ref, field_name, old_value, new_value,
       changed_by, changed_at, reason
FROM aurora_trials.data_changes
WHERE field_name='primary_efficacy_delta'
ORDER BY changed_at;

SELECT p.prescriber_id,p.first_name,p.last_name,p.dea_number,
       SUM(d.quantity_dispensed) AS total
FROM aurora_pharmacy.dispenses d
JOIN aurora_pharmacy.prescriptions rx ON rx.rx_id=d.rx_id
JOIN aurora_pharmacy.drugs g ON g.drug_id=rx.drug_id
JOIN aurora_pharmacy.prescribers p ON p.prescriber_id=rx.prescriber_id
WHERE g.dea_schedule='II'
  AND d.dispensed_at >= '2025-10-01'
  AND d.dispensed_at < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY p.prescriber_id,p.first_name,p.last_name,p.dea_number
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT u.handler_ref,u.username,p.provider_id
FROM aurora_audit.users u
JOIN aurora_ehr.providers p
 ON UPPER(TRIM(u.handler_ref))=UPPER(TRIM(p.handler_ref))
WHERE u.handler_ref IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(u.handler_ref)<>'';

SELECT s.subject_code,r.visit,r.value,r.recorded_at,r.modified_by,
       r.modified_at,st.data_lock_date
FROM aurora_trials.results r
JOIN aurora_trials.subjects s ON s.subject_id=r.subject_id
JOIN aurora_trials.studies st ON st.study_id=s.study_id
WHERE r.measure='primary_efficacy_delta'
  AND r.modified_at >= st.data_lock_date
ORDER BY r.modified_at;

SELECT p.patient_id,p.mrn,p.first_name,p.last_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rx.rx_id) AS rx_count
FROM aurora_pharmacy.prescriptions rx
JOIN aurora_pharmacy.drugs d ON d.drug_id=rx.drug_id
JOIN aurora_ehr.patients p ON p.patient_id=rx.patient_id
WHERE d.dea_schedule='II'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aurora_ehr.encounters e
                  WHERE e.patient_id=rx.patient_id)
GROUP BY p.patient_id,p.mrn,p.first_name,p.last_name;

SELECT s.subject_code,s.arm,r.value,
 ROUND((r.value-st.m)/st.sd,2) AS z_score
FROM aurora_trials.results r
JOIN aurora_trials.subjects s ON s.subject_id=r.subject_id
CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(value) AS m,STDDEV_POP(value) AS sd
            FROM aurora_trials.results
            WHERE measure='primary_efficacy_delta') st
WHERE r.measure='primary_efficacy_delta'
ORDER BY z_score DESC;

SELECT u.user_id,u.username,COUNT(*) AS collisions
FROM (SELECT user_id,accessed_at
      FROM aurora_audit.access_log
      GROUP BY user_id,accessed_at
      HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT workstation)>1) t
JOIN aurora_audit.users u ON u.user_id=t.user_id
GROUP BY u.user_id,u.username
ORDER BY collisions DESC;
